glb.glTF_convention: metres, Y up; canonical scene is metres, Z up

camera_transfer.interpretation: format transfer consistency, not physical camera calibration accuracy

limitations: static furniture with explicit conservative collision proxies
soft fabrics, hinged cabinets and movable objects are not dynamically identified
OBJ visual meshes use flat per-entity colors in MJCF; textured reference visuals are in Blender/GLB/USD

geometry.material_portability: Blender preserves procedural shaders; GLB/USD preserve image textures and supported PBR inputs, but procedural wood/fabric may become flat approximations.
geometry.usd_curve_policy: evaluated mesh copies; editable native curves retained in scene.blend

usd_export_adapter.evaluation: evaluated viewport geometry, same as canonical geometry audit
usd_export_adapter.subdivision: baked mesh; no implicit extra subdivision on import
usd_export_adapter.camera_names: camera data names normalized to stable object ids

limitations: Parameters labelled assumed are not physical calibration
Cloth uses triangular shell bending/stretching; volumetric soft body uses tetrahedral elasticity
Physics motion is separate from the frozen reconstruction pose

findings: Connected table trestles and rails remain clear under final shading.
Both chairs have rear-edge uprights, supported pads and grounded legs; no prior crossing front-to-back posts or averaged foot displacement.
Remaining rectangular-table corner fit up to 10.233 px and hidden joinery assumptions are explicitly reported.

visual_review.scope: Source-constrained display and structural reconstruction; no metric or physical truth certificate.

issues.description: Fixed-camera tabletop residual, exact back-rail curvature, hidden joinery, fine folds, lettering and precise shadows remain approximations.

scope: Engineering integrity, visual likeness and physical truth are separate verdicts.

loading.load_description: 0-300N distributed on cushion top then released; <=0.12N total gentle wind on unpinned garment vertices; 8Nm hinge torque for 1.3s

physics_review.review_basis: Agent inspected actual new start/mid/end frames showing visible green revised pad above its support, cloth motion and moving door, and checked numeric trajectory/load audits and actual GLB/USD reimports. Static furniture structural acceptance remains separate from numerical physics.

issues.description: Material/mass/gap parameters are assumptions. Small compliant contact penetration and joint-limit overshoot remain within declared tolerances; 2-second test is not long-horizon or measured physical validation. Curved back-rail collision is approximate/omitted. GLB exact camera requires delivered intrinsics metadata.
